“这或许又是一个机会。”
齐知玄目光微闪，心思深沉。
马绍波死后，他的位置不就空缺出来了吗？
“平时在媚香楼闹事的，其实多是喝醉酒的普通人，不需要多么强大的武力就能压制。”
齐知玄心中想着。
等他吃好早饭时，老鸨刚刚送走三位大股东，她一夜没睡，满脸憔悴，妆容都乱了。
“老板娘，累着了吧。”
齐知玄乖巧的递过去一杯热茶。
老鸨以手扶额，长叹口气，抱怨一句“倒霉催的”，这才接过茶杯，押了一小口。
齐知玄趁机说道：“老板娘，马爷不幸遇害，媚香楼现在缺少一个镇场子的，对吧？”
老鸨先是一愣，斜眼看了看齐知玄，撇嘴道：“大虎，有屁就放。”
齐知玄举起了手，拳头骤然迸射玉光，宛若鸡血石一般，微笑道：“我现在是玉皮武者，也能帮您镇场子。”
“玉皮？”老鸨脸色一变，深深看了眼齐知玄。
不知不觉间。
那个衣不蔽体、屁也不是的乡下穷小子，已然长成一个身高接近一米八的魁梧汉子，身材均称，肌肉饱满，五官棱角分明，让人刮目相看。
老鸨想了想，眼下媚香楼是多事之秋，的确不能没有镇场子的打手。
但是……
“大虎，你把这事想简单了。”
老鸨表情严肃起来，叹气道：“媚香楼的安保，向来是由三大股东负责，一般而言，每家派出一位高手过来。

通海商会，白狼帮，还有漕帮，一个萝卜一个坑。
他们三方人马，既负责镇场子，也负责监督我们所有人，以及互相监督，确保没有人作妖。
再者，在我媚香楼镇场子，那可是肥差，不但油水多，还有女人随便玩，大家争抢着来，哪里轮得到你？”
齐知玄遭到了鄙视，但这在他的预料之内，厚着脸皮道：“老板娘，我好歹可以算是媚香楼培养出来的自己人，一点机会都没有吗？”
老鸨翻个白眼，犹豫纠结片刻，又喝了口茶，悠悠道：“大虎，你能接受挂职吗？”
“挂职？”
齐知玄立刻点头道：“能，我愿意挂职。”
老鸨呵呵笑道：“先说清楚了，挂职的工钱只有正规人员最低薪酬的一半，也就是两千五百泥钞，但活一样干，有事还要冲在前头。”
“没问题。”
齐知玄完全可以接受这些。
反正他是白天练武，晚上在媚香楼打工，拿一半的钱合情合理。
“好，那你就从今晚开始镇场子吧。”
老鸨把茶杯递回来，打个哈欠，补觉去了。
“成了！”
齐知玄心情瞬间万分愉悦。

"This might be another opportunity."
Qi Zhixuan's eyes flashed slightly and his thoughts were deep.
After Ma Shaobo's death, wouldn't his position be vacant?
"The people who usually cause trouble in Meixiang Tower are mostly drunk ordinary people. They don't need strong force to suppress them."
Qi Zhixuan thought in his heart.
By the time he had finished his breakfast, the madam had just sent away the three major shareholders. She had not slept all night, her face was haggard, and her makeup was all messed up.
"Madam boss, you must be tired."
Qi Zhixuan obediently handed over a cup of hot tea.
The madam put her hand on her forehead, sighed, and complained, "I'm so unlucky." Then she took the tea cup and took a sip.
Qi Zhixuan took the opportunity to say: "Madam boss, unfortunately Mr. Ma was killed. Meixiang Tower now lacks a person to hold the place, right?"
The madam was stunned for a moment, then glanced sideways at Qi Zhixuan and curled his lips and said, "Big tiger, just fart if you want."
Qi Zhixuan raised his hand, and his fist suddenly emitted jade light, like a bloodstone. He smiled and said: "I am a jade-skinned warrior now, and I can also help you calm down the situation."
"Jade skin?" The old bustard's expression changed and he looked deeply at Qi Zhixuan.
Unknowingly.
That poor country boy with no clothes on his body and no buttocks had grown into a burly man nearly 1.8 meters tall. He had a well-proportioned figure, full muscles, and sharp features, which made people look at him with admiration.
The madam thought for a moment, and found out that Meixiang Tower was in troubled times right now, so it was necessary to have some thugs to keep things in check.
But...
"Dahu, you are making this simple."
The old bustard's expression became serious and he sighed: "The security of Meixiang House has always been the responsibility of the three major shareholders. Generally speaking, each family sends an expert here.
The Tonghai Chamber of Commerce, the White Wolf Gang, and the Cao Gang are all carrots and pitfalls.
They are a three-part team, responsible not only for holding the place, but also for supervising all of us, as well as supervising each other to ensure that no one behaves evilly.
Furthermore, in my town of Meixianglou, it is a fat job. Not only is there a lot of oil and water, but there are also women to play with, and everyone is vying for it. Where can you get your turn? "
Qi Zhixuan was despised, but this was within his expectation, so he said shamelessly: "Madam boss, I can be regarded as one of my own trained by Meixianglou, don't I have any chance?"
The madam rolled his eyes, hesitated for a moment, took another sip of tea, and said leisurely: "Dahu, can you accept the temporary job?"
"Take a temporary job?"
Qi Zhixuan immediately nodded and said: "Yes, I am willing to take up the post."
The old bustard chuckled and said, "Let me make it clear first, the salary of a temporary employee is only half of the minimum salary of a regular employee, which is 2,500 yuan, but the work is the same, and you have to rush ahead when something happens."
"No problem."
Qi Zhixuan can completely accept this.
Anyway, he practiced martial arts during the day and worked in Meixiang Building at night. It was reasonable to get half of the money.
"Okay, then you can start to control things from tonight."
The madam handed the teacup back, yawned, and went to catch up on her sleep.
"It's done!"
Qi Zhixuan felt extremely happy instantly.
